eips.title: Quick Slots
eips.summary: Quick Slots PR to be merged and included in Beta 5 release, with additional spec tests needed before cutting the release.

moments.context: Justin introduced EIP-8198 Quick Slots, noting the previous call decided to merge it quickly and make a Beta 5 release. Jihoon confirmed the PR would be merged after this call.

Nico raised concern that current spec tests do not actually test the Heze slot duration change, meaning clients could pass Beta 5 tests without implementing Quick Slots STF changes. Jihoon agreed to add tests before the release, targeting Thursday.
